# Placement and systems

> **Question:** where should each capability run, and how do you prove the choice?

## The margin

The placement decision itself, weighed against latency, energy, and privacy
budgets. This is the skill the whole course has been building toward.

**Properties in tension**: all of them at once. Placement is where the elements are explicitly traded.

## Components you use

- The full dual brain plus the cloud.

## What you build

Place each capability deliberately, then instrument it to justify the choice.

## What you measure

Latency, energy, and privacy per placement; a small benchmark harness that makes
the comparison repeatable.

## Read

MLPerf; edge-cloud offloading; energy profiling.
